#!/usr/bin/env bun
// A TypeScript source that reaches every field of the record as the
// TypeScript host fills it: each line kind, the starts, imported names
// left out of the code words, templates, regular expressions, handlers of
// each shape, a test. Some comments restate their statement on purpose.

import { Effect, Layer, Schema } from "effect"
import * as Http from "@effect/platform/HttpClient"
import type { Config } from "./config"

/**
 * Store keeps counts by key.
 */
export interface Store {
  /** Get is the count of key. */
  readonly get: (key: string) => Effect.Effect<number, Missing>
  readonly put: (key: string, n: number) => Effect.Effect<void>
}

export class Missing extends Schema.TaggedError<Missing>()("Missing", { key: Schema.String }) {}

// eslint-disable-next-line no-console
const debug = (line: string) => console.log(`debug: ${line} // not a comment`)

/** total is the sum of the counts of keys. */
export const total = (store: Store, keys: ReadonlyArray<string>) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    let total = 0
    for (const key of keys) {
      // get the count of the key
      const count = yield* store.get(key).pipe(Effect.catchTag("Missing", () => Effect.succeed(0)))
      // add count to total
      total += count
    }
    return total
  })

export function parseAll(texts: Array<string>, config: Config): Array<number> {
  const out: Array<number> = []
  for (const text of texts) {
    if (/^\s*\/\//.test(text)) continue
    try {
      // The texts come from users, so a bad one is reported, not skipped.
      out.push(Number.parseInt(text, config.radix ?? 10) / 1)
    } catch (error) {
      throw error
    }
  }
  return out
}

function describe2(n: number): string {
  try {
    return n === 0 ? "none" : `${n}`
  } catch {
    return ""
  } finally {
    debug("described")
  }
}

const live = Layer.succeed(Http.HttpClient, {} as never)

switch (process.argv.length) {
  case 0:
    break
  default:
    debug(describe2(1))
}

test("total of no keys", () => {
  expect(describe2(0)).toBe("none")
})
